plain_summary: Prahlad Singh Bhati vs N.C.T., Delhi & Anr.: The respondent-accused was released on bail despite being charged with murder. The court held that the Magistrate ignored basic principles governing grant of bail.
key_reasons: The Magistrate ignored reasonable grounds for believing the accused guilty of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life
The initial grant of anticipatory bail did not entitle the respondent to insist on regular bail even if he was subsequently found involved in a case of murder
